meta.title: Density Converter — Convert Kilogram/m³ and More
meta.description: Free density converter for 5+ units including Kilogram/m³, Gram/cm³, Gram/mL. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Kilogram/m³, g/cm³, lb/ft³. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 5 density units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for density in this tool is **kgm3**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most density conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Kilogram/m³ | kg/m³ |
| Gram/cm³ | g/cm³ |
| Gram/mL | g/mL |
| Pound/ft³ | lb/ft³ |
| Pound/in³ | lb/in³ |
content.use_cases:
- Reading datasheets where SI and imperial units appear side by side.
- Cross-checking CAD drawings against fabrication specs in a different system.
- Converting torque, pressure, or stress values for procurement.
- Translating field measurements into engineering reports.
- Spec'ing parts from international suppliers.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this density converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Kilogram/m³ (kg/m³), Gram/cm³ (g/cm³), Gram/mL (g/mL), Pound/ft³ (lb/ft³), Pound/in³ (lb/in³).
